responsibility: Implements the small Modula-2 compiler runtime exception helpers used by generated code, reporting unmatched `CASE`, missing `RETURN`, and explicit `throw` conditions to `stderr` before terminating the process. It is a minimal fatal-error support module rather than the full exception-block runtime.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation member of the Gmcrts pair: it emits the fatal diagnostics for CaseException, ReturnException, and _throw and terminates the process, whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gmcrts.h only publishes the exception-helper entry points for generated code.
